title: 第549章 瞧给孩子吓得脸都绿了第548章 那你也不要走了
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
“这黎门主真的是，非要来。”
“这下好了吧，不仅没把三位长老带回去，还把自己搭里边了……”
洛千影刚走出庭院玄关，正跟刘长老说着什么，便感应到头顶高空中传来一阵异样的灵气波动。
她抬头望去，只见一道血色遁光正以惊人的速度冲向天际。
“圣女，这是黎门主？”
身后的刘长老见状吃了一惊，这遁逃术的速度简直快到让人惊叹。
可洛千影却是轻笑着摇了摇头，遁术再快又能如何？
陆前辈可不是吃素的。
果不其然，就在那遁光即将消失在云层中的那一刻，却仿佛撞上了一堵无形的墙壁，戛然而止，生生定格在了半空之中。
洛千影望着高空之上的黎川，感慨道：
“黎门主啊黎门主，你说你这是何苦呢……”
……
……
而此刻的庭院中。
三位长老和一群血刀门弟子也纷纷仰头望着高空中那道被定住的身影，一时间议论纷纷。
“门主这是……唉……”
“门主这遁逃术在西漠确实是一绝，号称瞬息千里、无人能及，可到了陆前辈面前，连一个呼吸都没撑过去就被定住了，这差距……”
“我看咱们血刀门这是被打包了啊……”
“那也不错，咱们血刀门留在东荒成为天衍宗烟霞峰的人也挺好。”
“就是就是，这东荒本就山水秀美，再加上前辈又出手阔绰，这波不亏……”

……
高空中，被定住的黎川心中已经翻涌起滔天骇浪。
他的遁逃术乃是血刀门历代相传的秘法，以精血催动，一经施展便可瞬息移动数千里。
他在西漠纵横数百年，凭的就是这一手遁术。
无数次他都用这手遁术化险为夷。
可这一次，他连一个呼吸都没能撑过去，就被彻底定住了。
而且他甚至没有感觉到任何灵气波动，没有看到任何术法轨迹，就那么毫无征兆地被禁锢在了半空之中。
这位前辈……究竟是什么人物？！
黎川冷汗直冒。
他修行千年，从未听说过世间有这等存在。
就算是传说中的渡劫修士，也不可能做到这等地步吧？
就在黎川心中惊惧交加之际，庭院中传来陆鸣的一声轻叹。
他望着高空中那道被定住的身影，摇了摇头，语气中带着几分无奈：“还想跑，真的是……”
三位长老连忙上前一步，齐齐拱手求情道：“前辈息怒！门主他一时糊涂，冒犯了前辈，还望前辈手下留情！”
陆鸣摆了摆手：“放心，没打算杀他。”
说罢，他心念微动。
高空中，黎川只觉得一股无形的力量如同潮水般涌来，将他整个人包裹其中。
紧接着，一只看不见的巨手捏住了他的后颈，像是提溜一只不听话的野猫一般，将他从高空中缓缓拎了下来。
“前辈饶命！前辈饶命啊！”
content_en:
"This Li Sect Master really has to come."
"It's okay now. Not only did I not bring the three elders back, I also got myself involved..."
As soon as Luo Qianying walked out of the courtyard entrance and was talking to Elder Liu, she felt a strange wave of spiritual energy coming from the sky above her head.
She looked up and saw a bloody light rushing towards the sky at an alarming speed.
"Holy girl, is this the leader of the Li clan?"
Elder Liu behind him was shocked when he saw this. The speed of this escape technique was so fast that it was amazing.
But Luo Qianying chuckled and shook her head, so what if the escape technique is faster?
Senior Lu is not a vegetarian.
Sure enough, at the moment when the escaping light was about to disappear into the clouds, it seemed to have hit an invisible wall, stopped abruptly, and was frozen in mid-air.
Luo Qianying looked at Li Chuan high in the sky and said with emotion:
"Master Li, Master Li, why are you doing this..."
…
…
And in the courtyard at this moment.
The three elders and a group of Blood Knife Sect disciples also looked up at the frozen figure in the sky, and started talking about it for a while.
"Master, this is... alas..."
"The escaping skills of the sect master are indeed unique in the Western Desert. They are said to be able to travel thousands of miles in an instant and are unmatched by anyone. But when they were in front of Senior Lu, he was frozen in place without even taking a breath. This gap..."
"I think our Blood Knife Sect has been packed away..."
"That's not bad. It's also good for our Blood Knife Sect to stay in the Eastern Wasteland and become members of Tianyan Sect's Yanxia Peak."
"That's right, this Eastern Wilderness has beautiful scenery, and the seniors are generous with their spending, so it's not a loss..."
…
High in the sky, Li Chuan, who was frozen, was already filled with waves of terror.
His escape technique is a secret technique passed down from generation to generation by the Blood Knife Sect. It is activated by blood essence and can move thousands of miles in an instant once used.
He has been in the Western Desert for hundreds of years, relying on this escape technique.
Countless times, he used this escape technique to avert danger.
But this time, he couldn't even hold on for a breath before he was completely frozen.
And he didn't even feel any spiritual energy fluctuations, didn't see any spell tracks, and was imprisoned in mid-air without any warning.
Who is this senior... exactly? !
Li Chuan broke into a cold sweat.
He has been practicing for thousands of years and has never heard of such existence in the world.
Even the legendary tribulation monks couldn't possibly achieve this, right?
Just as Li Chuan was filled with fear, Lu Ming's sigh came from the courtyard.
He looked at the frozen figure high in the sky and shook his head, with a hint of helplessness in his tone: "I still want to run, really..."
The three elders hurriedly took a step forward, and they all raised their hands and begged: "Senior, please calm down! The sect master was confused for a moment and offended senior, so I hope senior will show mercy!"
Lu Ming waved his hand: "Don't worry, I don't intend to kill him."
After saying that, his thoughts moved slightly.
High in the air, Li Chuan felt an invisible force coming in like a tide, wrapping him up in it.
Immediately afterwards, an invisible giant hand pinched the back of his neck, like lifting a disobedient wild cat, and slowly lifted him down from the sky.
"Senior, have mercy on me! Senior, have mercy on me!"
